findings.text: Seven DoD command references have no matching command in their node's verification array: unique-repair and one-free-retry in revise-validated-and-converging; absence-grep-flagged and no-model-call in proof-writable-before-review; contested-output in contested-plan-resolves-from-answers; and run-refuses-other and supervise-refuses-other in managed-block-does-not-block-launch. Each references an unfiltered single-file invocation, while verification declares a filtered invocation and a directory-wide suite. Those are different commands, so the references have no corresponding verification index when frozen. Register the referenced invocations or bind these proofs to the existing unfiltered suite entries.
nodes[0] (human-step-carried-by-frozen-plan) has verification but worker runtime claude-opus uses permissionMode=acceptEdits; claude executes commands only in bypassPermissions
